topic: Cheech: a ride-sharing app is really three products
caption:
From the passenger seat, a ride-sharing app looks like one app. Building Cheech showed us it's really three. 🚗

▸ The rider experience: book fast, see where the car is
▸ The driver experience: clear requests and simple navigation
▸ The backend in the middle: real-time data that connects both sides

Each one needs its own design thinking, and all three have to work together in real time.

Cheech is live on Google Play, with iOS on the way to the App Store.
